items.desc_en: Opposition leaders have alleged that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party during elections.
items.desc_zh: 反对派领导人指控 CEC Gyanesh Kumar 在选举期间操纵选民名册以支持总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的政党。

items.title_en: Student riots engulf France as far-right presidential frontrunner Le Pen vows fiscal turnaround
items.title_zh: 法国极右翼总统候选人勒庞誓言扭转财政局面，学生骚乱席卷法国
items.desc_en: A teenager reportedly lost a hand in the protests, which have seen over 5,000 people arrested.
items.desc_zh: 据报道，一名青少年在抗议活动中失去了一只手，抗议活动已导致 5000 多人被捕。

items.title_en: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants feature
items.title_zh: Ofcom 调查 Instagram Instants 功能上的 Meta
items.desc_en: The regulator said Instagram had not fully assessed risks posed by its Instants feature prior to launching it.
items.desc_zh: 监管机构表示，Instagram 在推出 Instants 功能之前并未对其所带来的风险进行全面评估。

items.title_en: Nigeria mourns as 32 killed when military plane crashes into swamp
items.title_zh: 尼日利亚哀悼军用飞机坠入沼泽 32人丧生
items.desc_en: President Bola Tinubu describes the crash as a "painful moment" for the military and the entire nation.
items.desc_zh: 总统博拉·蒂努布将这次坠机事件描述为军队和整个国家的“痛苦时刻”。

items.title_en: Lego fraudster among last year's most high-profile insurance scammers
items.title_zh: 乐高诈骗者跻身去年最引人注目的保险诈骗者之列
items.desc_en: The person was sentenced to 28 months in prison after an investigation found the claims were made up, the insurance trade body, the ABI said.
items.desc_zh: ABI 表示，保险行业机构调查发现这些索赔都是捏造的，此人被判处 28 个月监禁。

items.title_en: Separatist party projected to win Quebec election, adding new test to Canada's unity
items.title_zh: 分离主义政党有望赢得魁北克选举，为加拿大团结增添新考验
items.desc_en: The Parti Québécois, which secured a minority, has vowed to hold an independence referendum in the years to come.
items.desc_zh: 获得少数席位的魁北克党发誓要在未来几年举行独立公投。

items.title_en: Yemeni military says it has 'secured' Red Sea waterway
items.title_zh: 也门军方表示已“保护”红海航道
items.desc_en: Saudi-backed forces gave conflicting reports of whether they had also seized the port city of Mokha, near the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
items.desc_zh: 沙特支持的部队对于他们是否还占领了曼德海峡附近的港口城市莫卡给出了相互矛盾的报告。

items.title_en: Pentagon stops using Anthropic AI tools after blacklisting company, BBC told
items.title_zh: BBC 称，五角大楼在将公司列入黑名单后停止使用 Anthropic 人工智能工具
items.desc_en: It labelled Anthropic a "supply chain risk" in February after the firm refused to remove safety guardrails from its tools.
items.desc_zh: 二月份，在 Anthropic 拒绝拆除其工具上的安全护栏后，该公司将其标记为“供应链风险”。
